Scene: A broad street and residential terraces in the abandoned human colony, a few months after evacuation in 2189. A 28mm elevated camera from a sheltered school entrance looking down into an empty district built within a basalt valley. Most homes remain standing; one transit skybridge has collapsed at a structurally plausible support, one roof is punctured, doors have been carefully propped open for evacuation. Dust has collected around children's small shoes, a tipped school chair and an abandoned wheeled suitcase under the foreground shelter. No bodies, no gore. Warm daylight filters through a cracked greenhouse roof beside the school; a few plants are still alive, an automated irrigation nozzle still drips. In the midground an empty communal dining table has three cups neatly set out; do not let props overwhelm landscape. Small green battery lamps guide from doorways toward a distant sheltered underground entrance. Alien pale gas giant only partly visible through thin silver-blue morning clouds. No busy crowds, no giant mecha, no ubiquitous fire. A windblown strip of curtain, dry dust, intact ordinary rooms seen through windows, silence. Emotional intent: a home abandoned in an organized evacuation, and the haunting expectation that someone might return.

Scene: A dramatic but physically coherent landscape showing HOW the colony's main transmission tower was destroyed. High wide aerial oblique establishing view of the isolated relay complex in a broad mineral basin at stormy night, distant mountain ranges and a pale ringed gas giant behind haze. At the exact instant of a precision orbital strike: ONE narrow searing white-blue beam descends from above frame and hits the tall central antenna's power junction. The upper antenna buckles at the melted structural joint; enormous sections visibly separate along the tower's construction seams, dropping into a localized orange-white explosion. A circular pressure wave lifts dust across the paved service yard; fragments follow believable ballistic arcs, not a uniform shower of decoration. Nearby structures remain mostly intact, their small amber windows abruptly darkening in patches. High-power cables arc briefly near the impact; outer independent green evacuation lamps along a road remain visibly lit. Several tiny armored emergency vehicles moving away establish scale. Make destruction causally readable: point of impact, severed load-bearing structure, falling antenna, displaced dust. Beautiful severe composition, horrific scale with restraint. No human injury, no corpse, no magical planet-cracking beam, no mushroom cloud, no wall of fire obscuring architecture. This is an old defense system eliminating a transmission source, not random apocalyptic chaos.

assets.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather / environment time transformation. Edit target: the supplied ancient coastal city artwork. Create its far-future ruined counterpart as one complete cinematic landscape of ECHO-9. Preserve the ORIGINAL CAMERA POSITION, framing, recognizable coastline, major left-side monumental ring arch, elevated curved bridges, left foreground balcony, and the exact pale gas giant and ring geometry in the sky. This must read unmistakably as THE SAME LOCATION long after the ancient civilization vanished, not a new generic ruin. Remove the parent and child completely; their absence is the emotional center. Remove the ships, living trees, vines, fabric banners and inhabited city lights. Age stone and metal over many millennia: rounded broken edges, long erosion runnels, part of the great ring arch collapsed with its fallen segment logically below, several elevated bridges missing spans while original supports remain, toppled waterfront spires. The sea has largely receded, exposing vast pale salt flats, sediment terraces, cracked seabed and only a narrow distant dark remnant of water following original shoreline. The foreground railing still bears the same two incomplete circles, deeply worn but recognizable. Introduce a subtle RECENT human exploration path made of just five very small battery-powered emerald-green guide lamps following the remaining balcony and lower route, one beside the empty spot where the child once stood. Distinguish fresh human lamps from ancient ruins. Lighting becomes cold overcast late afternoon with a narrow shaft of warm light touching the empty balcony, subdued pale slate and sand palette. High-detail realistic premium game environment art, atmospheric distance and wistful stillness. No people, no mecha foreground, no active explosion, no skulls, no captions, no UI, no watermarks. Scene: An astonishing immense underground ark vault, landscape-scale interior that explains what was preserved beneath destruction. Camera on a broken human inspection catwalk in foreground, 24mm wide view into a cavern several kilometers across. The ancient architecture has beautiful eroded crescent ribs and two almost-touching ring motifs, enormous vaulted chambers and terraced reservoirs. A collapsed rock ceiling has crushed the left half of the facility: fallen structural ribs, pulverized glass preservation vessels and a dry channel. The RIGHT half still works, behind intact curved clear containment glass: a living forest of delicate alien plants and mature fernlike trees, tiny white flowers and shallow clear water, lit by soft warm artificial daylight. Thousands of dim amber preservation pods recede into the far walls. The contrast between destroyed and carefully protected life should be immediately legible in ONE continuous believable space, not split-screen. A fragile line of small emerald-green lamps on recent human battery housings leads along a hand-repaired walkway around the collapse toward a distant staffed-looking shelter with one warm window; no visible people necessary. One foreground planter holds an ordinary terrestrial green seedling next to a closed small toolbox and folded blanket. A huge dormant biological-mechanical guardian rests in shadow beside the living habitat, its posture protective, barely a silhouette and secondary to landscape. Fine mineral dust, tiny water reflections, roots around old technology, sophisticated subtle lighting; no toxic green fog, no all-green color wash. Emotional intention: so much has been lost, but someone is still protecting the possibility of a future.
